summary_1line: Duryodhana sends Uluka to the Pandavas with taunts and challenges, invoking a parable about hypocrisy and urging them toward the impending war.

image_candidates.scene_text: A cat stands on the Ganges bank with forepaws raised like an ascetic while trusting birds and mice gather around it in reverence.
A group of mice carry the seemingly holy cat toward the river while the well-fed predator secretly devours them one by one.
Duryodhana laughs in his war camp while privately instructing Uluka to deliver insulting challenges to the assembled Pandavas.
